name: Troilus Gold Corp.
summary: Troilus Gold Corp. operates as an advanced stage exploration and early-development company in Canada. The company focuses on the mineral expansion and potential mine re-start of the former gold and copper Troilus mine. Its Troilus gold property consists of 1,988 mineral claims and 1 surveyed mining lease covering an area of 107,326 hectares located Northeast of the Val-d'Or district within the Frotêt-Evans Greenstone Belt in Quebec, Canada. The company was incorporated in 2016 and is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.
